name: @baxyz/browser-hub
description: Launch any browser profile from the GNOME indicator.
author: baxyz <berenger@arnaud.work>

scripts.install:local: pnpm build && cp metadata.json dist/ && rm -rf "$HOME/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/browser-hub@baxyz.etik.com" && cp -r dist "$HOME/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/browser-hub@baxyz.etik.com"
scripts.pack: pnpm build && cp metadata.json dist/ && (cd dist && zip ../browser-hub.zip -9r .)
scripts.shexli: pnpm build && cp metadata.json dist/ && (shexli "$PWD/dist" || (echo 'shexli not found — install with: pipx install shexli' && exit 1))
